chapters.title: Chapter 501: Ten Months in the Blink of an Eye
paragraphs: At this moment, Gu Le linked her arm through Yang Fan’s and walked into the living room.
“Husband has been waiting for me there all day and must be exhausted. Let’s hurry up and eat.”
Yang Fan’s footsteps paused slightly, and he glanced guiltily at Lu Wan beside him.
At this moment, Lu Wan couldn’t help laughing either.
She quickly raised her right hand, gently covered her mouth, and forcefully suppressed her smile.
It was rare for Yang Fan’s old face to blush.
Fortunately, Gu Le didn’t notice at all and enthusiastically pulled him over to eat.
The meal ended quickly. Lu Wan put down the tableware in her hand and then looked at Gu Le.
“There is still a master bedroom downstairs. Since I am pregnant with a child, Sister should accompany Husband more during this time.”
After saying that, she got up and went upstairs.
Until the door was closed, the smile on Lu Wan’s face could finally no longer be suppressed.
“I didn’t expect Husband to like telling little lies on ordinary days.”
She sat in a chair, the corners of her mouth turning up slightly.
“However... it’s not annoying either.”
Thinking of Yang Fan’s serious and nonsense-spouting appearance just now, the smile in Lu Wan’s eyes grew even stronger.
Afterwards, she gently shook her head, her eyes filled with happiness.
“Husband is indeed still different to me.”
“No matter big or small matters, he basically won’t hide them from me.”
Speaking of this, the smile on Lu Wan’s face gradually became gentle.
“I will definitely help Husband manage this family well.”
She lowered her head and gently stroked her lower abdomen, which was not yet significantly bulging, her face full of maternal love.
On the first floor of the villa.
Right after finishing the meal, before Gu Le could react, she felt her body lighten.
“Ah!”
Yang Fan directly picked her up horizontally and strode towards the bedroom.
Gu Le’s pretty face flushed slightly, but she didn’t struggle. Instead, she took the opportunity to wrap her arms around Yang Fan’s neck.
The bedroom door slowly closed, and soon, the commotion inside the room grew louder and louder.

“A newlywed may not surpass a long absence, the fire burns fiercer upon return after a long separation; Intending to become a god and turn the tables to be the master, in the end, she still obediently rested.”
In the first half of the night, Gu Le somewhat still had the thought of “I am now a god too, it is finally my turn to hold my head high”.
Unfortunately...
The ideal is plump, but the reality is bony.
When she was tossed about until the second half of the night, she finally realized.
Breaking through to a god seemed to not have caused any substantive change to her spot on the bed.
Early the next morning, sunlight filtered through the curtains.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes, lowered his head to glance at Gu Le who was still sleeping soundly beside him, and the corners of his mouth couldn’t help curling into a smile.
“Wanting to turn the tables and become the master just after achieving a breakthrough to a God? Take a look at your own weight.”
After saying that, Yang Fan gently shook her head, his mood obviously very good.
Following Gu Le and Gu Chengye officially moving in, this originally slightly quiet villa gained a bit of angry instead.
The villa’s space was already extremely large, so having two more people move in wasn’t crowded at all.
The subsequent life also returned to its former rhythm.
During the day, Yang Fan sat in the main seat.
Lu Wan and Gu Le sat on his left and right sides.
While eating, Lu Wan would occasionally chat about things related to divine kingdom investments and listed companies.
For example, which industries were worth laying out recently, which divine kingdom projects had good future prospects, or which company in the Real World was developing at a high speed.
Although Yang Fan wasn’t very interested in this, he didn’t perfunctorily brush it off, but instead listened patiently.
On the contrary, Gu Le listened extremely attentively every time.
That appearance was simply like a newcomer who had just started learning to do business, afraid of missing a single sentence.
With a serious look of “I want to work hard to earn money and get rich”.
Lu Wan didn’t hold anything back regarding this; after all, they were a family now.
The stronger she and Gu Le became, the greater their usefulness to Yang Fan would be.
Lu Wan arranged everything very thoughtfully.
Aside from the nanny robots, she even replaced the entire floor of the villa’s first floor with polymer buffer materials produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.
Even if Gu Chengye hugged his head and ran blindly around the house, he wouldn’t get hurt.
A few days later, Yang Fan also deeply realized a problem for the first time.
He... seemed to have started raising a child.
Today’s Gu Chengye was no longer as simple as just being able to speak.
This little fellow had terrifyingly exuberant energy and had even begun learning to cause trouble and destroy things.
Especially when Yang Fan occasionally wanted to return to the massage room for a quiet rest, Gu Chengye could always sense it the very first moment.
Then he would command his robot nanny to run straight over and knock on the door.
“Daddy! Open the door! Play with me!”
Regarding this, Yang Fan could only cover his forehead helplessly.
Children from wealthy families were indeed smarter.
But the problem was... Gu Le spoiled this son far too much.
Cleverness plus pampering—the superposition of these two things was destined to make this little fellow even harder to manage.
Time passed blandly just like this.
In the blink of an eye, ten months passed.
To the Real World, it was merely a short ten months, but to Yang Fan’s divine kingdom, it had evolved for nearly thirty thousand years once again.
During this period, Yang Fan successively purchased five Xuan-grade Secret Realms through Chen Bo’s channels, becoming new believer gathering places and war troop reserve bases.
The military forces in his hands were becoming increasingly sufficient.
Those high-tier believers within the divine kingdom experienced round after round of replacement of the old with the new.
Thirty thousand years of time were enough for countless generations of believers to be born, grow up, and grow old.
The once-familiar faces had already been replaced by goodness knows how many batches.
However... even though the divine kingdom had developed to its current degree, still not a single believer truly broke through to a brand-new Realm.
Regardless of which route it was, that existence capable of breaking the bottleneck never appeared.
However, although the Realm did not break through, the number of believers in the Nascent Soul Realm and Martial Emperor Realm had ushered in a terrifying growth, multiplying by nearly ten times.
Besides this, during these ten months, Yang Da relied on the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card to deduce the divine kingdom coordinates of seven Foreign Deitys one after another.
There was the Rock Armor Race, whose bodies were covered in metal shells and renowned for defense.
There was the Illusion Butterfly Race, which excelled in Mental Strength.
There was also an alien race named the Blood Feather Race, whose believers possessed extremely strong speed and flight capabilities.
These Foreign Deitys deduced through the demigod core had fundamentally no power to resist in front of Yang Fan’s currently massive believer army.
Match after match of Divine Kingdom War ended almost in a crushing manner.
During this period of time, including the Divine Kingdom Core of that previous Black Armored Beetle Race god, Yang Fan swallowed a total of eight Divine Kingdom Cores.
[Divine Kingdom Area: 17.7 billion square kilometers]
Looking at his current divine kingdom area, Yang Fan couldn’t help frowning.
He felt that his luck didn’t seem very good.
Among these eight Foreign Deitys, only one reached a Tier 3 God, two were Second-Order Gods, and the remaining five were all First-Order Gods.
What made Yang Fan even more helpless was that as his divine kingdom area became increasingly massive, the area increase brought by devouring Divine Kingdom Cores also became smaller and smaller.
After tossing about for nearly a year, he still hadn’t reached twenty billion square kilometers to break through to a Second-Order God.
“No wonder those Low-rank Deitys can live for tens of thousands of years at every turn.”
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 502: How Much Money Is Left to Squander?
paragraphs: Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh.
“A god’s Divine Kingdom coordinates are extremely difficult to obtain in the first place, and the risks of a Divine Kingdom War are extremely high.”
“Even if one miraculously wins in the end and obtains the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core, after devouring it, the expansion range of the Divine Kingdom is pitifully small.”
This was just like leveling up in a game.
Leveling up was lightning-fast in the Early Stages, but the further along one got, the more experience needed to be accumulated, and the difficulty of leveling up exploded exponentially.
It was just that unlike other gods,
Yang Fan didn’t have to worry about war and cost issues.
As long as he could deduce the Divine Kingdom coordinates of an Foreign Deity, he would dispatch a large army to invade without the slightest hesitation.
In the Real World, in as short as half a month or as long as two months, he could bring back the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.
As for the various resources required for the Divine Kingdom War, Yang Fan didn’t feel a pang of heartache at all.
After all... the consumption of war wasn’t even as much as what he earned from his Divine Kingdom investments.
If others were to know that Yang Fan was still dissatisfied with his own progress, they would probably be so angered that they would vomit blood.
In less than a year, the area of his Divine Kingdom had skyrocketed all the way to 17.7 billion square kilometers.
With this kind of growth speed, even looking across the long history of the Human Federation, I’m afraid not many could be found to compare with it.
A Tier 3 God like Gu Jiuheng, backed by the Gu Family and spending year-round at the frontline participating in legion wars,
even so, it had taken him nearly five hundred years to grow all the way from a First-Order God to Tier 3.
And what about Yang Fan?
Not long after his breakthrough to godhood, his Divine Kingdom had already expanded to 17.7 billion square kilometers.
Other gods, having just made a breakthrough, were still cautiously cowering and developing.
Every day they researched Divine Kingdom investments and calculated resource outputs.
In order to nurture believers, they didn’t hesitate to take out loans from their Clan, seek external financing, or even sell off their own assets.
But look at Yang Fan.
How long had it been since he broke through to godhood, and he had already absorbed over a dozen Divine Kingdom Cores from other gods!
This wasn’t developing at all; it was clearly treating Divine Kingdom expansion like an assembly line.
Aside from the expansion of the Divine Kingdom, over these ten months, the auction transactions on the Dark Web had almost never stopped.
As long as something was valuable for the development of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da would basically keep his eyes on it.

Aside from S-Rank resource-type buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the Ancient Tree of Enlightenment, Yang Da had also successively won bids for a Heavenly Court and two War God Codexes from the Dark Web.
In order to acquire more military merits, Yang Da would bid on a portion of alien S-Rank Buildings through the Dark Web every month and then hand them over to the Han Family.
As for the military merits obtained from the exchange, they were all used to redeem the Heavenly Court and the War God Codex.
This reselling operation’s consumption of Divinity Points was naturally extremely terrifying.
But for Yang Fan today, it was just so-so.
After all, compared to the output of those resource-type buildings in the Divine Kingdom, this bit of consumption really didn’t count for much.
Currently, within the Divine Kingdom, top-tier S-Rank Buildings like the Heavenly Court and the War God Codex each numbered seventeen.
This just happened to reach the upper limit that the current Divine Kingdom area could bear.
Besides that, there were still 50,000 military merits left in the military merit System, but no suitable consumption direction had been found for the time being.
Of course, they could all be taken to exchange for resource-type S-Rank Buildings.

But for Yang Fan today, the greatest value of these types of buildings was no longer increasing the income of Divinity Points, but further enhancing the overall cultivation environment of the Divine Kingdom.
Yet... the cultivation environment of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was already exaggerated enough.
As for income?
Yang Fan truly didn’t need it.
As for him now, he had so many Divinity Points that he couldn’t even finish spending them.
In ten months, both the Divine Kingdom and the Real World were frantically consuming funds.
But even so, the balance of Divinity Points in his Divine Kingdom still broke through tens of quadrillions.
What was even more exaggerated was that a large amount of Earth Core Spirit Milk and enlightenment tea leaves were still stockpiled within the Divine Kingdom.
These were the assets that truly gave Yang Fan a headache.
Nowadays, every month he only dared to take out a fixed portion to hand over to the Yang Corporation.

After all, the production volume of these things was simply too terrifying. If they suddenly flowed into the market in large quantities, even with channels like the Battlefront Star Sector Chamber of Commerce of the Yang Corporation, it would still be very difficult to clearly explain their origin.

The Hundredfold Evolution Talent and S-Rank Growth of All Things, coupled with the massive scale of resource-type buildings that had already snowballed within the Divine Kingdom, had formed a terrifying resource-producing machine.
Yang Fan even felt that nowadays, every time he opened his eyes, his most headache-inducing problem had changed from “how to make money” to another matter.
“So much money...”
“How on earth should it be spent?”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh.
The troubles of a rich person were truly unpretentious.
And bitter.
Very bitter.
Even though Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had developed to such an extent, his life in the Real World remained excessively low-key.
During this period of time, Gu Jiuheng had invited him back and forth several times.
The meaning was very simple: join the Ninth Legion, personally participate in the Divine Kingdom War, and carve out a world for himself at the frontline with his own strength.
Regarding this kind of matter, Yang Fan’s answer had always been just two words— “Not going.”
He didn’t lack resources, let alone military merits.
Why bother running to the frontline personally to fight and kill?
As for the Star Group founded by Han Jue, since it was currently in the Early Stage of development, a total of three board meetings had been held during this period.
Every single time, Yang Fan followed Lu Wan and arrived punctually.
When the meeting started, did he listen carefully?
Not very carefully.
When the meeting ended, did he need to sign?
Wherever Lu Wan told him to sign, he signed.
As for those thick documents... Yang Fan was even too lazy to take an extra look.
He really had no interest in the meager, pitiful returns of the Star Group.
Anyway, whatever Lu Wan had looked over, he would just sign it.
As for the development of the Yang Corporation, Ma Yu had always been keeping an eye on it.
In these ten months, the consumed funds had already reached five hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Seeing that the funds were almost exhausted, Ma Yu finally couldn’t sit still anymore.
Just when he was at his wit’s end... Yang Fan turned around and injected another five hundred trillion Divinity Points into his Divine Kingdom.
Furthermore, he didn’t go through the public account of the Yang Corporation, but directly transferred this huge sum of Divinity Points into Ma Yu’s Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan still remembered that face of Ma Yu, which was complex to the extreme when he received the notification from the intelligent lifeform in the Virtual World back then.
There was no sense of relief, no surprise.
Instead... it was even more bitter.
That expression seemed to silently recount:
“How much money does this boss of mine... actually have left to squander?”
Nowadays in the entire Battlefront Star Sector, the Yang Corporation even had an extremely special reputation—a large-scale charity company.
That’s right, a charity company.
As for any sunset industries related to food, transportation, energy, and other sectors, the Yang Corporation almost accepted all comers, directly waving a big hand to take full control.
Even industries with infuriatingly low yields were willingly taken over by the Yang Corporation.
The only benefit was...
Nowadays, no matter where Ma Yu went, whether it was local government officials or executives of listed companies, seeing him basically meant receiving the highest standard of hospitality.
Why?
Because everyone knew that the Yang Corporation behind President Ma... had money.
And was willing to take over.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 503: A Wage Slave's Life is Still a Life
paragraphs: A vast number of people holding low-yield assets were itching to shove them right into Ma Yu’s hands to cash out immediately.
In the eyes of these people, the Yang Corporation was practically a walking sucker.
Ma Yu was well aware of this.
Whether it was local governments or corporate executives, on the surface everyone praised him for his strategic vision.
“What farsightedness!”
“What long-termism!”
“What a proactive layout for the future!”
But Ma Yu could guess with his pinky toe that these people were undoubtedly cursing him behind his back.
In fact... there were likely many people pulling up stools to watch the show.
Just waiting for the day when he, the “ultimate sucker,” would be kicked out of the Yang Corporation.
Ma Yu suffered in silence; he really didn’t want to do any of this!
It was all the boss’s orders!
Moreover, Ma Yu had been waiting.
Waiting for Lu Wan to realize that something was off with the Yang Corporation’s investment direction.
And then, through a family meeting, sternly correct her husband’s completely derailed investment philosophy.
Unfortunately... Lu Wan was currently resting to prepare for childbirth.
She didn’t seem to have much energy to pay attention to company affairs.
Thus, under Yang Fan’s “incomparably brilliant” investment strategy... Ma Yu could only hold back tears and keep spending money.
One transaction after another, spending more and more.
Until finally, Ma Yu even began to question his life choices.
On this day.
Xiling Planet, Yang Corporation Headquarters Building.
Ma Yu was in his office handling various recent affairs of the corporation.
Knock, knock, knock!
A knock suddenly sounded at the door.
“Come in,” Ma Yu said softly, rubbing his sore brow.
The office door opened, and a smart robot walked in holding a stack of documents.
“General Manager Ma, this is a project Chairman Yang personally inquired about. Please sign it.”
Saying so, the smart robot respectfully handed the documents to Ma Yu.
“Here we go again...” Ma Yu’s mouth twitched slightly.
Lately, he had grown somewhat afraid of seeing these kinds of documents.
However, since it was a project Chairman Yang had personally taken interest in, he didn’t dare neglect it and could only bite the bullet and open it.
In the next instant, an eye-catching title came into view.
[Overall Acquisition Plan for ST Huoneng Group Co., Ltd.]
The moment he saw this title, Ma Yu felt his vision go dark.
“Wait...”
“It’s already ST-listed, and Master still wants to acquire it?”
He suppressed the urge to vomit blood and kept reading.
Huoneng Group had recorded a profit margin below three percent for three consecutive years.
The company’s operations were deteriorating daily; even its own shareholders had begun selling off fixed assets one after another, preparing to cash out and exit.
How was this an asset?
A 3% return was purely losing money! Using Divinity Points to casually buy some Federal Treasury Bonds would beat this.
“What’s there to acquire in a company like this?” Ma Yu asked with a face full of confusion.
The smart robot shook its head.
“This is Chairman Yang’s decision.”
Ma Yu fell silent.
Suppressing the ill omen in his heart, he flipped directly to the last page of the document.
There, a row of numbers was written prominently.
[Acquisition Offer: 30 Trillion Divinity Points]
The office instantly fell into a dead silence.
“Fuck!”
The next moment, Ma Yu slammed the document onto the desk.
“If I sign this, it’ll definitely be the greatest disgrace of my investment career!”
“30 trillion?”
“This garbage company is worth 30 trillion?”
The smart robot carefully reminded him:
“General Manager Ma, this is a tender offer project personally requested by Chairman Yang.”
Ma Yu took a deep breath, and his expression, which was so worked up he wanted to curse moments ago, forcibly calmed down.
“Fine, since Master wants to acquire it, then we’ll follow the M&A procedure.”
“Contact all the shareholders of Huoneng Group for me and convene an M&A plan conference.”
At this point, Ma Yu’s eyes turned cold.
“However, 30 trillion?”
“I think these people have gone mad with greed!”
“The only things truly valuable in the entire Huoneng Group are those two living planets.”
“As for the rest of that scrap metal, I’d find it a waste of space even putting it in a Divine Kingdom.”
“Slash the price down to 10 trillion for me.”
“At the same time, release news to the public.”
“If they don’t accept this price, we abandon this merger and acquisition entirely!”
The smart robot paused slightly. “General Manager Ma, but...”
“I know this is Master’s intention.”
Ma Yu waved his hand.
“Isn’t this a negotiation?”
“Besides, those shareholders are far more anxious right now than we are.”
“Nobody’s Divinity Points fell from the sky.”
“Every bit saved for Master counts.”
After saying this, Ma Yu seemed to suddenly lose all his strength.
He let out a long sigh, slumped back into his chair, his face full of bitterness.
As an employee, sometimes the most helpless thing is that no matter how outrageous the boss’s decision is, you still have to figure out a way to execute it.
The boss is responsible for setting the direction, and the employees are responsible for finding a way.
As for whether the direction the boss points to is actually a cliff...
That wasn’t something a mere wage slave like him could decide.
Since he couldn’t stop it, he could only do his best to minimize the losses.
At least... he couldn’t let the boss actually squander the whole family fortune!
If the price of 30 trillion was actually agreed upon, there probably wouldn’t even be anyone to take it off their hands in the future.
Thinking up to this point, Ma Yu couldn’t help but look out the window.
“Mistress...”
“This really has nothing to do with me.”
“Please hurry up and finish giving birth, then come back to take over the company!”
“If this goes on, all those Divinity Points you gave Master will probably be completely blown away by him!”
The more Ma Yu thought about it, the sadder he felt.
Unlike their first meeting, after investigating, Ma Yu had long since uncovered Lu Wan’s true background.
This Mistress was no ordinary person.
Standing behind her was a mother who was a High-Order God, and she herself held a massive amount of shares in listed companies.
She even had voting rights in those giant mega-corporations on the Federal Main Board.
In Ma Yu’s view, the high probability reason why Yang Fan could mobilize such a massive amount of funds now was that Lu Wan gave it to him.
Apart from living off a woman, he really couldn’t imagine where a young man who had just recently become a god got so many Divinity Points from.
Even so, Ma Yu still felt anxious.
Because over the past year, the Divinity Points he had spent on Yang Fan’s behalf were already enough to buy his life several times over!
And yet his boss didn’t even blink an eye when spending money.
Thinking back on the projects he had come into contact with during this time, Ma Yu felt his scalp go numb.
When others invest, they try to make ten thousand Divinity Points work like twenty thousand.
His boss, on the other hand...
...seemed desperate to find ways to turn one hundred thousand into ten thousand, and then complained he wasn’t spending fast enough.
Ma Yu lowered his head and took a glance at the acquisition plan on the table.
“Sigh, forget it. At least this time I can save 20 trillion Divinity Points for the boss.”
Thinking of this, he forced himself to cheer up.
“A wage slave’s life is still a life.”
“I hope Mistress won’t blame me after learning what happened!”
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 504: Good Dad
paragraphs: On this day, the villa where Yang Fan lived unusually bustled with activity.
Medical robots continuously entered it, and various precision medical equipment were successively delivered.
In this day and age, childbirth itself had long since ceased to be a dangerous matter.
Even for a Divine Being Procreation the next generation, the probability of dystocia was almost negligible.
Let alone that Lu Wan was now a deity.
Logically speaking, there was no need to make such a big fuss at all.
But the problem was... this was Yang Fan’s home after all.
Even though he was currently at the frontline, for Lu Wan’s delivery this time, Yang Fan had transferred a large number of medical robots and professional instruments from other living planets.
As for various emergency plans, who knew how many sets had been prepared in advance.
Just as the medical robots were busy, a small figure grabbed Yang Fan’s hand.
“Dad.”
Gu Chengye tilted his head up with a curious look on his face.
“Is Mother Lu going to have a baby? Is it a younger brother or a younger sister?”
“A younger brother.” Yang Fan said directly without even thinking.
Hearing this, Gu Chengye couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
“Dad, isn’t your Y chromosome a bit too strong?”
“There are already three boys, I want a younger sister!”
“Forget it this time, but in the future, Daddy, you must give me a younger sister.”
Speaking of this, Gu Chengye suddenly stroked his chin like a little adult and began to analyze seriously.
“Right, I heard that Mother Lu seems to have bought shares in a medical giant listed on the Federation main board.”
“Why don’t you try in-vitro fertilization next time, Dad?”
“That way the success rate is a bit higher.”
“Otherwise, if our family keeps going like this, I’m afraid the Yangs will truly have an imbalance of yin and yang.”
Finished speaking, Gu Chengye even prepared to continue popularizing science with a serious expression.
Hearing this, Yang Fan only felt his temples twitching.
This brat... He’s not old, how does he know everything?
“Scram!”
Yang Fan rubbed his temples with annoyance.
“Does your brat want a spanking again?”
Gu Chengye chuckled, obviously not taking it to heart at all.
With his age constantly growing, coupled with Gu Le’s pampering since childhood, this little fellow had become increasingly lawless.
Especially since he didn’t like staying honestly at home at all.
He ran outside every other day.
To ensure the safety of this precious son, Gu Le even specially arranged a private guard team for him.
Among them, there were even as many as two First-Order Gods.
Even Yang Fan, his biological father, could now only see him once every month or two in the Real World.
Sometimes Yang Fan couldn’t help but doubt where on earth this wet-behind-the-ears brat went to play every day.
If it weren’t for the family about to welcome a new member today, Gu Chengye would probably still be running wild outside.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help asking, “Where have you run off to recently?”
“I went to inspect work.”
Gu Chengye answered righteously and with full confidence.
“Huh?”
Yang Fan was startled.
“What work are you inspecting?”
“No... what work do you have?”
Gu Chengye immediately showed an expression of being looked down upon.
“Dad, you really shouldn’t look down on me.”
“I am very busy!”
“Last month, I spent quite a lot of money!”
Saying that, he began to count with his fingers.
“The guard team’s salary and security expenses, space lane tolls between major living planets.”
“Starship docking fees, planetary hotel expenses.”
“Amusement parks, Virtual World entertainment consumption.”
“And various specialty restaurants, living planet limited-edition snacks...”
“Adding everything up, last month I sent you a credit bill of one thousand Divinity Points!”
Yang Fan: “...”
He looked at Gu Chengye in front of him, who was obviously a circle fatter than before, and the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
“So, your job... could it be tasting snacks across various living planets?”
“And then making me pay?”
Gu Chengye immediately became unhappy.
“Dad, what kind of words are those?”
“I am working seriously!”
“Have you forgotten?”
“I am now the actual controller of two listed companies in the Battlefront Star Sector, and I am also a major shareholder of the Yang Corporation!”
Speaking of this, he immediately stood straight, his expression extremely serious.
“I am very busy! These are all public relations expenses, who made you my guardian, shouldn’t you pay for them?”
“Fine, fine, fine.”
Yang Fan was too lazy to expose him.
“You’re busy, you’re busy.”
“However, you must pay attention to safety when you are outside.”
“Don’t go to those overly remote living planets.”
“Before achieving a breakthrough to a deity, you must protect your Physical Body in the Real World even better.”
“You must know that a gentleman does not stand under a tottering wall.”
Gu Chengye nodded.
“I know, Mom has already nagged me about it.”
“And last month I stayed on Xiling Planet all along, not running around blindly at all.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally felt a bit more at ease. “Then you didn’t cause trouble for your grandparents, did you?”
“No!”
Gu Chengye shook his head immediately.
“Grandpa and Grandma like me a lot.”
But speaking of this, he suddenly curled his lips.
“It’s just that... Older Brother Yang Chengrou is a bit boring.”
“I originally wanted to take him to play on other living planets, but Big Brother is too timid.”
“Afraid of danger here, afraid of accidents there, and in the end he actually had to go home to ask Mother Luo Rou for instructions.”
Speaking of this, Gu Chengye was obviously somewhat dissatisfied.
“What do you think he was thinking?”
“After looking for Mother Luo Rou, do he and I still have a chance to go out?”
“I’m afraid my temporary credit card would be frozen on the spot.”
The more Gu Chengye talked, the more spirited he became.
“Big Brother is truly petty.”
“If this goes on, when he grows up in the future, he will definitely be a complete mama’s boy.”
Yang Fan listened with his eyelids twitching wildly.
“If you were half as well-behaved as your older brother, I could worry a lot less.”
Gu Chengye curled his lips, obviously unconvinced by these words.
But the next moment, as if suddenly remembering something, his eyes instantly lit up.
“Dad, today is a grand and joyous day after all.”
“Can you agree to a small request of mine?”
Yang Fan looked at him vigilantly. “Speak.”
“My Divine Kingdom has not undergone Awakening yet.”
Gu Chengye immediately put on a pitiful expression.
“The company’s dividends, the living planet’s taxes, and some baby fund shares are all locked up right now.”
“Good Dad... just sign your name for me.”
“The request isn’t high.”
Gu Chengye extended a finger.
“Just help me raise my usage permission from zero point one percent to one percent.”
“Just a tiny bit.”
As he spoke, he also added very sensibly: “I have everything ready!”
While speaking, Gu Chengye’s small eyes also quickly swept around the surroundings.
After confirming that there was no one nearby, he secretly took out a somewhat crumpled folded piece of paper from his bosom.
Afterward, he very skillfully stuffed it into Yang Fan’s hand.
Looking at the contents on the paper, Yang Fan raised his eyebrows.
“What do you want so many Divinity Points for?”
“Didn’t I already give you a supplementary card from the Federal Bank?”

chapters.title: Chapter 505: The Son Wants, the Son Gets
paragraphs: Although Gu Chengye is only a few years old now, the wealth he holds has long surpassed that of the vast majority of ordinary deities.
Just one percent of the dividends from Yang Corporation and the income from the living planets under his name is an astronomical figure that would make ordinary deities green with envy.
Therefore, Yang Fan naturally could not easily sign this authorization letter.
Having a lot of money is one thing, but for a child of a few years old to control such massive wealth is inherently a dangerous matter.
Although Yang Fan is not afraid of trouble, he would not truly let Gu Chengye run wild.
Looking at his father’s expression, which clearly showed a lack of reassurance, Gu Chengye quickly said:
“Of course it is investment!”
“Mother Lu Wan is the mother I admire the most.”
“In the future, I want to follow her example and become a formidable capitalist tycoon!”
When saying this, Gu Chengye’s little face was incomparably earnest, without a trace of joking intention visible.
Yang Fan looked at him and ultimately shook his head helplessly.
“Fine, suit yourself.”
Having said that, Yang Fan picked up a pen and signed his name on the authorization letter.
Afterwards, he handed the document to Gu Chengye.
“Take it, but remember, the money can be used, but pay attention to safety.”
“Got it!”
Gu Chengye took the document, and a brilliant smile immediately bloomed on his face.
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“Alright, hurry up and go play outside.”
“Don’t disturb me here.”
“You got it, Daddy!”
Gu Chengye put away the document, turned around, and bolted out in a flash.
Until the door closed again, Gu Le walked out from the side room.
Yang Fan glanced at her and said calmly:
“He is still too young.”
“Wife Le’er, you must not spoil him too much.”
In fact, the biggest reason why he was willing to sign just now was because Gu Le had sent him a voice transmission.
Otherwise, Yang Fan truly would not have agreed so easily.
Regarding the education of his children, Yang Fan has always rarely intervened personally.
To be precise, he basically handed over the cultivation of the children to their respective mothers.
Mainly because he is lazy; how to raise the children... let them worry about it themselves.
Ever since Yang Chengrou moved to Xiling Planet, Luo Rou directly activated the tiger parenting mode.
Politics, law, economics, divine kingdom investment, and various basic knowledge—almost none were missed, and the best teachers were arranged in advance.
Under this educational environment, Yang Chengrou developed a habit from a young age.
Whenever encountering anything, she would first consult her own mother.
Children cultivated this way might lack a bit of freedom, but they excel in being obedient enough.
Every time Yang Fan went to the Virtual World to meet his family, no matter what Yang Chengrou was doing, she would run over at the first moment to greet him.
She was obedient to an unbelievable degree.
As for Gu Chengye, he was completely the opposite extreme.
Gu Le doted on this son far too much.
“Wants it? Given.”
“Likes it? Bought.”
“Wants to play? Arranged.”
The core theme is ‘what the son wants, the son gets’.
As a result, Gu Chengye naturally developed a bit of a Demon King personality.
But this educational method also had its own benefits.
At least compared to Yang Chengrou, Gu Chengye was more lively, bolder, contacted more things, and no one knew how many bizarre thoughts popped up in his head every day.
The two children completely walked down two completely different paths.
Yang Fan was about to welcome his third son soon, and he was also very curious about what kind of personality this child would be cultivated into under Lu Wan’s guidance in the future.
“Husband, it’s fine.”
Gu Le, however, had an expression of utter indifference.
“When children are young, they shouldn’t blindly stuff knowledge into their heads.”
“At this age, what’s more important is to let him understand this world.”
“Seeing more, walking farther, and contacting more people and things, he will slowly understand what he truly wants.”
“What we can do is to hold up a piece of the sky for him when he doesn’t have the ability to face this world alone.”
“As for what path he wants to take in the future, let him choose for himself.”
“With us backing him up from behind, he will always find his own position and realize his own value.”
Gu Le said it casually.
After hearing this, Yang Fan also felt it made quite a bit of sense.
Children cannot live under the protection of their parents forever.
What he could do was simply give them more opportunities and a supportive push along their growing path.
“Fine.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“However, safety issues still need attention.”
“Didn’t Yang Corporation just acquire a security group recently?”
“Doesn’t Gu Chengye still have ten percent of the shares?”
“Doesn’t he feel like he’s an adult? Let him go find Ma Yu himself and upgrade the security forces.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s tone gradually became solemn.
“Also, tell him, gender discrimination is not allowed!”
“A half-grown child running around everywhere all day, I can accept sending a few powerful deities to protect him.”
“As a result, he insists on specifying female guards?”
“Only you could agree to such a ridiculous demand.”
Speaking to the end, Yang Fan couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
You can tell what someone will be like from childhood.
He was now starting to suspect that his own son was a lecher.
If it developed like this, he was afraid there really was a momentum of blue coming from indigo and surpassing indigo.
Hearing this, Gu Le couldn’t help laughing.
In that expression, there was even a faint hint of approval for her own son.
Obviously... she didn’t seem to think there was any problem with Gu Chengye’s little hobby.
Right at this moment.
A loud cry suddenly came from the second floor of the villa.
Yang Fan and Gu Le were stunned at the same time.
“Born!”
The next moment, the two stood up almost simultaneously and walked quickly upstairs.
Just as they reached the door of the room, a smart robot responsible for maternity services greeted them.
It bowed ninety degrees to Yang Fan.
“Mr. Yang, the maternity service has been completed.”
“The newborn’s vital signs are healthy, and all indicators are normal.”
“Please enter the newborn’s name, and the System will automatically and in real-time connect to the Federal Population Information System.”
As its voice fell, a light blue electronic light screen slowly floated above the robot’s head.
Inside the room, Lu Wan had already put her clothes back on.
At this moment, she was holding the baby in her arms, her face filled with tenderness and maternal love.
Seeing Yang Fan enter, Lu Wan gently raised her head.
“Husband, what is our child’s name?”
Yang Fan felt a bit awkward all of a sudden.
To be honest, he really wasn’t very good at naming things.
“I’m not very good at naming.”
“Wife Wan’er, you do it.”
Lu Wan thought about it.
“In that case... let’s name him Chenglu.”
“Chenglu?”
Yang Fan’s expression was a bit odd.
Why does it sound... a bit strange?
Lu Wan smiled and explained:
“It’s the Lu of road, I hope that throughout his entire life, he will never stop his footsteps.”
“Life itself is a path that constantly moves forward.”
“I hope that no matter where he goes in the future, he can keep walking, see farther places, and walk out his own path.”
Saying this, Lu Wan lowered her head and looked at the child in her arms.
“Yang Chenglu, what does Husband think of this name?”
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 506: Major Progress
paragraphs: “Ah?”
Yang Fan was suddenly stunned for a moment.
“Surnamed Yang?”
“Is this okay?”
It wasn’t that Yang Fan cared about whose surname the child would take.
In fact, for him, what surname the child had didn’t matter at all.
Yang Chengrou taking his surname Yang was because the Luo Family was just an ordinary Clan in Yang County.
After he displayed his talent, the status of both sides had already changed, so it was naturally nothing inappropriate for the child to have the surname Yang.
But Lu Wan was different.
Standing behind her was the Lu Clan, one of the Five Great Families of the Human Race.
Although Yang Fan himself didn’t care about such things, he had to consider the attitude of the Lu Clan.
If because of a surname issue, it made the Lu Clan feel uncomfortable... that would be somewhat losing more than it was worth.
Therefore, at this moment, Yang Fan was even more cautious than Lu Wan.
“There’s nothing bad about it.”
Lu Wan gave a light snort, her face full of indifference.
“What does my child’s surname have to do with those stubborn old fogies of the Clan?”
“At most, when Chenglu has his Awakening of the Divine Kingdom in the future, the subsidy obtained from the Lu Clan will just be a little less.”
“These subsidies, I will give him ten times, a hundred times!”
Speaking to the end, Lu Wan’s face even carried a bit of dominance.
Gu Le on the side, hearing this, also couldn’t help but give a thumbs-up.
“Big sister is still the best!”
The cultivation of direct descendants by the Five Great Families was no small matter.
After every direct descendant completes the Awakening of their Divine Kingdom, they can obtain an extremely generous tilt in Resources from the Clan.
Especially top Families like the Lu Clan, the subsidies given were enough to make ordinary gods turn red with envy.
Only a true wealthy woman in the real sense like Lu Wan could completely disregard these Resources.
For her, what did it matter if the Lu Clan gave a little less? If worst came to worst, she would make up for it herself.
Hearing Lu Wan say this, Yang Fan completely put his mind at ease.
Since it was just a little less Clan subsidy, naturally he didn’t care either.
“Alright, then let’s name him Yang Chenglu!”
Yang Fan nodded, then reached out and entered the child’s name on the electronic light screen.
[Name: Yang Chenglu]
Just at this moment, a sound of “pa” suddenly came from the doorway.
A small toy bear fell to the ground.
Hearing the sound, everyone looked over and saw that Gu Chengye had run to the doorway at some point.
At this moment, his face was pale, his eyes were lifeless, and his whole person was as if he had suffered some huge blow.
As if... the sky had fallen.
“What’s wrong, Chengye?”
Seeing this, Gu Le hurriedly walked over and hugged him into her arms.
“It’s over... The sky has fallen!”
Gu Chengye said with a crying tone.
Seeing this scene, the few people present were all dumbfounded.
Even Yang Chenglu, who was lying in Lu Wan’s arms, opened his hazy eyes and curiously looked at this little older brother who suddenly started crying.
“Why does the older brother have the surname Yang, and the younger brother also have the surname Yang?”
“Only I alone have the surname Gu!”
The more Gu Chengye thought about it, the sadder he became.
“In the future, if I inherit Dad’s Clan business, wouldn’t I naturally be in a disadvantaged position?”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan directly rolled his eyes.
Inherit the Clan business?
How old is this brat? Starting to consider this kind of thing already?
“Brat! Hurry up and go play with mud in the courtyard!”
“Isn’t that ten percent of the Yang Corporation shares in your hands enough?”
“You still want to go to heaven?”
Yang Fan deliberately put on a stern face.
Hearing this, Gu Chengye quickly wiped the tears from the corners of his eyes, and then said indignantly:
“I’ve learned a lot of knowledge on the internet!”
“Everyone says that the struggle for the heir apparent has always been like this!”
“Mother Lu is richer than my mom, and now younger brother also takes Dad’s surname.”
“When we all grow up in the future, younger brother eats meat, wouldn’t I only be able to follow along and drink soup?”
“My heart is suffering!”
Speaking to the end, Gu Chengye even covered his chest and made a look of angina.
That acting skill... was simply exaggerated to the extreme.
Yang Fan, Lu Wan, and Gu Le looked at each other.
The next moment.
“Hahahaha!”
The three of them could no longer hold back and laughed out loud at the same time.
This little fellow wasn’t old, but his wits were more numerous than the last.
Precocious and mischievous, perhaps that’s what such a child is called.
In the end, nobody knew what Gu Le said to Gu Chengye in private.
Anyway, not long after, Gu Chengye, who had just looked like the Clan property was going to be snatched away by his younger brother, regained his spirit.
The sadness on his face disappeared faster than flipping a book.
When night came, the villa gradually quieted down.
Everyone had already rested, but a small figure quietly sneaked out of the room.
It was precisely Gu Chengye.
He tiptoed to the nursery.
Confirming there was no one around, he gently pushed open the room door.
In the room, Yang Chenglu was sleeping quietly.
Gu Chengye stood by the bed and looked at him for a while, then gently placed the toy bear in his hand into the younger brother’s arms.
“Hehe, third brother.”
“This was my favorite toy when I was little.”
“Just now I was busy acting pitiful to cheat Mom’s money, and almost forgot the gift for you.”
Gu Chengye muttered in a low voice.
“You are still young now and don’t understand anything.”
“But it doesn’t matter.”
“There are still more than ten years until you complete your Awakening of the Divine Kingdom.”
“By that time, your older brother’s industries will definitely have spread all over the entire Battlefront Star Sector.”
“Hang out with big brother in the future.”
“Big brother will cover you!”
Finishing these words, Gu Chengye couldn’t help but yawn.
He was a child after all, having tossed and turned for a whole day, he finally couldn’t resist the sleepiness.
He was obviously too lazy to return to his own room.
His whole person just slumped onto the ground, and not long after, he fell fast asleep.
On the second floor, Lu Wan was lying on the bed.
Her Mental Strength, however, saw everything downstairs clearly.
Watching Gu Chengye, who had secretly run into the baby’s room and given his favorite toy to his younger brother, Lu Wan couldn’t help but curve the corners of her mouth into a smile.
“This child...”
She gently shook her head.
“Taught quite well; I didn’t dote on him in vain.”
On the other side, inside the massage room.
Yang Fan was comfortably lying on the massage bed.
However, unlike the relaxation of his body, his consciousness had long since entered the Divine Kingdom.
The moment his consciousness appeared within the Divine Kingdom palace, Yang Da’s figure quickly rushed over.
“Master! Major progress!”
There was even a bit of undisguised excitement in Yang Da’s voice.
Hearing this, Yang Fan was stunned, and asked strangely, “What progress?”
As a god, he could feel that there was no special change in the Divine Kingdom.
“Reporting to Master, it’s the ghost cultivation route!”
Yang Da immediately reported.
“Ever since the Divine Kingdom acquired the soul Seed” talent, Yang Yi has been studying various materials related to the soul and Mental Strength.”
“At the same time, he has also used these ghost cultivation believers to conduct a large number of experiments.”
“After tens of thousands of years of research and attempts, he has finally found a combat style truly suitable for ghost cultivation believers.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan instantly became interested.
With a thought, he brought Yang Da and instantly appeared ten thousand meters above the sky of the Divine Kingdom.
Looking down from here, Yang Fan quickly saw the area on the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom that was specially carved out for the survival of ghost cultivation believers.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 507: Natural Avatars
paragraphs: After more than 30,000 years of Evolution, the area of this region had long expanded by over a thousand times.
And now, the number of ghost cultivator believers living here had also exceeded 100 million.

Among them, the ghost cultivators in the Nascent Soul Realm exceeded a thousand, those in the Core Formation Realm reached 100,000, and those in the Foundation Establishment Realm numbered as many as ten million.
The rest were all in the Qi Refining Realm.
These ghost cultivators had no physical bodies, so the living space that was extremely important to ordinary living beings was not important to them at all.
What they truly needed were a large number of Spirit Plants and special Resources capable of nourishing the Divine Soul.
Moreover, having lost their Physical Bodies, they theoretically had no lifespan limits in the normal sense at all.
As long as they possessed sufficient supplements of Resources to keep the Divine Soul from perishing, they could continue to exist indefinitely.
Of course, reality was not that simple.
After high-level believers died, the proportion of them successfully transforming into ghost cultivators was not high.
Therefore, even though the Divine Kingdom had evolved for tens of thousands of years, the scale of believers on the ghost cultivator path was still only over 100 million.
Compared to the massive ethnic groups in the Divine Kingdom that easily numbered in the trillions or tens of trillions, it did not even count as a fraction.
“How do these ghost cultivators actually fight?”
Yang Fan asked curiously.
Although the ghost cultivator believers now numbered over 100 million, in Yang Fan’s view, their combat style still had fatal flaws.
Having no Physical Body meant that their defensive capabilities were extremely weak.
What of over 100 million ghost cultivators?
I am afraid any casual army of 10,000 soldiers could easily completely annihilate a large area of ghost cultivator believers.
After all, the so-called Soul Power was essentially just a special kind of energy.
Even if bombarded by the energy cannons of an Intelligent Mecha, they would likewise suffer heavy injuries.
“Master, please look.”
Yang Da reached out and pointed to an open space on the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom.
“This is the current combat method of the ghost cultivators.”
Yang Fan followed his finger and saw that an experimental area had been specially cordoned off there.
A large number of ordinary beasts were locked in specially made cages, clearly as subjects specifically used for experiments by Yang Yi.
At this moment, an adult giant wolf was being secured in the center of the experimental field.
Crackle!
Accompanied by a flash of dazzling electric light, a strong current instantly pierced through the giant wolf’s body.
This adult giant wolf, fully two meters long, twitched a few times before completely losing all movement.
And another giant wolf nearby saw this scene, instinctively baring its fangs.
Driven by wildness, it slowly approached, seemingly preparing to devour its dead companion.
But right at this moment, a pitch-black figure suddenly swept over from the distance.
The next moment, that black shadow directly merged into the body of the dead giant wolf.
“Boom!”
The giant wolf that had originally lost its breath of life suddenly shook its body.
Immediately following, a bizarre force erupted from within its body.
Its bones began to expand, and its muscles bulged frantically.
Its body size, which was originally only around two meters, unexpectedly kept growing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Three meters! Four meters! Five meters!
The originally normal wolf body had now completely turned ferocious and terrifying.
Its grayish-black eyes lacked the slightest luster, the muscles beneath its fur seemed almost ready to burst through the skin, and ferocious fangs protruded from the corners of its mouth.
Its entire physique was permeated with a bizarre sense of dead silence.
The other giant wolf preparing to share and eat its kind saw this scene, its pupils violently contracting.
It instinctively took a step back.
Right at this instant.
Boom!
That possessed giant wolf instantly vanished from where it stood.
The next moment, its massive physique had already appeared before the other giant wolf.
Terrifying power erupted with a roar, and the giant wolf did not even have time to resist before its head was fiercely pressed into the ground.
Fresh blood splattered everywhere, and the battle ended so fast that it was dizzying.
And that giant wolf that had completed possession slowly turned around.
Afterwards, it actually crawled prostrate toward the direction where Yang Fan was located.
“This is...”
A trace of surprise flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Possession?”
“Reporting to Master, to be precise, this method is called—Resurrection through a Borrowed Corpse.”
Yang Da explained.
“This is a special technique mastered by the alien Soul Spirit Race.”

“According to the Federation’s existing data, believers of the Soul Spirit Race can lodge their own spirit in all things of heaven and earth, using Mental Strength to control external objects for combat.”
“That is to say, even if they are defeated in a Divine Kingdom War, they will only consume Mental Strength, and the believers will not perish together with the lodged Physical Body.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately became interested.
Yang Da continued:

“After comparing a large amount of data, Yang Yi discovered that the Cultivation Technique of the Soul Spirit Race has an extremely high degree of compatibility with the believers of the ghost cultivator path in the Divine Kingdom today.”
“Fortunately, many wars broke out between the Human Race and the Soul Spirit Race in the past, so this Cultivation Technique could be found in the miscellaneous data library of the Federal Mall.”

“After passing ‘Resurrection through a Borrowed Corpse’ to the ghost cultivator believers, through thousands of years of continuous improvement, experimentation, and practice, it can finally be executed now.”
Yang Da’s voice paused.
“At present, as long as it is a creature that has already died, ghost cultivators can attempt to possess and control it.”
“Whether it is the Human Race, the Demon Race, or other alien races, they can all become their lodging bodies.”
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly, “Are there no other restrictions?”
“Of course there are.”
Yang Da immediately replied.
“First, the ghost cultivator’s own Soul Power must match the possessed Physical Body.”
“For example, a ghost cultivator in the Qi Refining Realm possessing a Physical Body of the Qi Refining Realm can unleash combat power close to its complete level during life.”

“If it is a ghost cultivator in the Foundation Establishment Realm possessing a Physical Body of the Qi Refining Realm, under the condition of sufficient Soul Power, they can even forcibly erupt with stronger power.”
“However, this kind of enhancement also has its limits.”
“The stronger the ghost cultivator’s own strength, the stronger the Physical Body they can naturally control.”

“Conversely, if the ghost cultivator’s own Realm is too low, yet they forcibly control a Physical Body far exceeding their own level, not only will they be unable to unleash the full strength of the Physical Body, but they may even cause the Physical Body to become a burden in turn due to insufficient Soul Power.”
After listening, Yang Fan did not speak.
His gaze fell upon the ferocious giant wolf demon below.
A moment later, the surprise in his eyes gradually turned into excitement, and even faintly carried a trace of hard-to-conceal agitation.
What kind of ghost cultivator path was this?
This was clearly... a natural “avatar”!
As long as different Physical Bodies were prepared for these ghost cultivator believers, they could instantly transform and become completely different races.
The more Yang Fan thought about it, the brighter his eyes became.
“This really is... sending a pillow right when one feels sleepy!”
Originally, he had always been worried about how to avoid leaving his own traces after invading the Divine Kingdoms of human deities in the future.
But now it seemed a solution to this problem had been found.
Yang Fan’s breathing unconsciously grew a bit heavier.
Now the development speed of his Divine Kingdom was already startlingly fast, yet he was still unsatisfied.
Yang Fan knew very well that with his SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, his biggest restriction right now was no longer Resources, but the Divine Kingdom Core!
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 508: Money Is Just Money
paragraphs: As long as he could continuously devour sufficiently powerful Divine Kingdom Cores, his divine kingdom would be able to expand crazily, and the combat power of the entire divine kingdom would grow exponentially.
Recruiting Subordinate Gods on the frontline, hunting Alien Demigods, and then relying on the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card to find the coordinates of Foreign Deitys...
Although these methods were effective, they were always too slow.

Moreover, as the area of the divine kingdom grew larger and larger, the Divine Kingdom Cores provided by those ordinarily-powered Foreign Deitys had increasingly limited expansion effects for Yang Fan.
But the Human Race was different; not only could they drop better talents, but more importantly, deductions could be carried out through the divine kingdom information in the Real World!
Even for a Genius of the Peerless Prodigy level, as long as one was willing to pay a sufficient price, they could still obtain the other party’s divine kingdom coordinates.
Yang Fan had long since harbored corresponding thoughts in his heart.
However, at that time, he did not have the conditions to do so.
First, the development time of Yang Corporation was too short, and it simply lacked similar businesses and channels.
Second, once this kind of thing was done too much, it would inevitably attract the attention of the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
He was currently the Peerless Prodigy valued by the entire Human Race, glamorous and shining.
Yang Fan certainly did not want to end up in a situation where everyone wanted to beat him.
But now... the biggest problem among them seemed to have a solution.
Ghost cultivation!
As long as ghost cultivation believers were used for the invasion, those “invaders” appearing on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield could naturally disguise themselves as other races.
Clearly it was an alien invasion, what did it have to do with him, Yang Fan?
Heaven and earth destroy those who do not look out for themselves.
In this world, it has always been big fish eat small fish, and small fish eat shrimp.
High-Order Gods exploit Low-rank Deitys; governments exploit enterprises; enterprises exploit employees; and employees in turn exploit their own believers.
If one wanted to become a person above others, naturally one had to eat people.
When all was said and done, being in a higher position simply meant possessing more Resources and stronger power than others.
And where did those Resources and power come from?
Naturally, they were taken from others.
As long as it was done covertly enough without leaving evidence pointing to oneself.
Then Yang Fan on the surface could still be that young human Genius, the upstart whom the Five Great Families were willing to befriend, and the Prodigy of the human faction.
As for what was actually done behind the scenes...
Whether one was human or ghost, what did it matter?
The world only ever needed to see the glamorous surface.
As for what truly lay beneath that layer of glamour, the world was simply not qualified to care!
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze gradually grew profound.
“Yang Da, you should understand what I want to do, right?”
As the highest intelligent lifeform of the divine kingdom, Yang Da naturally understood Yang Fan’s thoughts.
Moreover, it itself did not possess human moral concepts.
For it, as long as it was beneficial to the development of the divine kingdom, it was worth executing.

“Reporting to Master, using ghost cultivation believers to invade human gods to evade the investigation of the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence theoretically possesses a fairly high feasibility.”
However, speaking of this, a trace of pause appeared in Yang Da’s voice.
“However, the ghost cultivation path itself currently has severe limitations.”
“Currently, there are only over one hundred million ghost cultivation believers in the divine kingdom.”
“With this quantity, no matter how many war supplies and Smart Weapons are equipped, when truly facing the divine kingdoms of other gods, I’m afraid they won’t even kick up a splash!”
Yang Fan furrowed his brows slightly, “How to solve it?”
Yang Da immediately began to analyze.
“First, increase the ghost cultivation population.”
“Ghost cultivation believers originate from the conversion of high-order believers in the divine kingdom after death.”
“This requires the accumulation of a large amount of divine kingdom time.”
“Moreover, because the divine kingdom talent cannot act upon the Secret Realm, those who can be converted into ghost cultivators can only be believers in the main divine kingdom.”
“Second, Master needs to find a way to absorb more Divine Kingdom Cores with soul-type talents.”
Yang Da said earnestly:
“The fundamental reason why the proportion of high-order believers converting into ghost cultivators after death is currently so low lies in the fact that Soul Seed is only of C-rank.”
“If this talent rank can be raised, the growth speed of the ghost cultivation path will inevitably increase significantly.”
“Besides this, a large number of alien high-order corpses will also need to be purchased subsequently.”

“And if we want ghost cultivators to unleash their corresponding combat power, Mechanical Civilization will similarly need to invest a lot of time researching weapons adapted to the physical bodies of different alien races.”
Yang Da finished speaking in one breath.
“These are all just difficulties at the divine kingdom level.”
“As long as Master is willing to continuously invest Resources and give enough time, I am confident I can help Master truly establish this path.”
Yang Fan nodded. This path was not easy, but with his Evolution Talent, he could at least see hope.
However, Yang Da quickly continued:
“However, if Master truly wants to thoroughly walk through this path, the truly difficult part is not the divine kingdom, but the Real World.”
“According to the public data of the Federal Government, privately investigating the divine kingdom information of other gods is a serious illegal act.”
“Wanting to evade the investigation of the Federal Government and intelligent lifeform is not a simple matter.”
“The development time of Yang Corporation currently founded by Master is still too short.”
“It only possesses a certain amount of influence in the Battlefront Star Sector, but viewed from the entire Human Race, its foundation is still insufficient.”
Yang Da’s voice gradually grew solemn.
“Especially the secret investigation capability.”
“Although Yang Corporation currently has the ability to collect public intelligence, it has not established a true sense of intelligence system.”
“Wanting to investigate a human god’s real identity, divine kingdom development trajectory, and even deduce their divine kingdom coordinates without alarming anyone...”
“Relying solely on today’s Yang Corporation is still far from enough.”
Yang Fan took a deep breath.
“It seems... the burden is heavy and the road is long!”
He knew very well that wanting to truly establish an intelligence system capable of secretly investigating human gods was by no means something that could be completed in a short period of time.
“Yang Da, grant Yang Yi more fund-usage authority.”
“Purchase Spirit Plants capable of nourishing Divine Souls and carry out large-scale Planting.”
“As for how to develop subsequently, wait for my news.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da said respectfully.
Having given all instructions, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from the divine kingdom.
Inside the massage room, Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
The next moment, under the control of his Mental Strength, a fountain pen and a piece of white paper slowly floated into mid-air.
The pen suspended itself, and the tip fell upon the surface of the paper.
Swish, swish, swish!
Soon, three lines of characters appeared on the paper.
“First, increase the number of ghost cultivation believers.”
“Second, raise the rank of soul-type divine kingdom talents.”
“Third, establish an investigation company.”
Writing to this point, the pen slowly stopped.
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then his Mental Strength stirred slightly.
The pen heavily drew an asterisk behind the third item.
Yang Fan let out a long breath, and his gaze looking out the window gradually grew profound.
Once a person had money, they would crave power.
The ultimate desire of a person was power.
Once one had power, money and people would automatically gravitate toward them.
But money was always money, and it was just money.
(That’s a Wrap!)

Isn’t that the same as saying nothing?

“Besides, haven’t you always regarded your Mom Lu as your role model?”
“Then be obedient. Furthermore, the teachers hired for you this time are all Mid-tier Gods who have spent tens of thousands of years deeply cultivating themselves in the education industry.”
“Your Mom Lu has paid twenty years of tuition all at once.”
“Read obediently for two years first. Once your younger brother is a bit older, the two of you brothers can take classes together.”
Hearing this, how could Gu Chengye still not understand?
These two moms... were afraid they had already discussed this in advance!
He simply didn’t have any room for negotiation today.
Thinking of this, Gu Chengye’s eyes rolled around.
Since reasoning didn’t work... then he could only use a child’s ultimate weapon.
Crying!
He pouted his lips, preparing to burst into a loud cry.
“Wa—”
Before the sound could even come out, Lu Wan had already anticipated his anticipation in advance.
“Don’t you like investing?”
Gu Chengye’s crying instantly stuck in his throat.
“In the Battlefront Star Sector, I happen to have a private company holding three major financial licenses for banking, insurance, and securities.”
“It hasn’t gone public yet.”
Lu Wan spoke in a calm tone, as if casually mentioning a trivial matter.
“As long as you obediently listen and finish your courses seriously.”
“I will give this company to you.”
Gu Chengye instantly quieted down.
A trace of a smile appeared at the corner of Lu Wan’s mouth as she continued coaxing him step by step.
“Compared to you running amok in the securities market with a large sum of capital right now, thinking every day about buying low, selling high, and getting rich overnight...”
“What I am giving you is the true Righteous Path.”
“Could it be that our Clan’s Chengye only wants to be a big retail investor in the future? Do you not want to manipulate the market yourself?”
“Manipulate the market?”
Gu Chengye’s eyes lit up instantly.
The next moment, his small body stood up straight from the chair.
“I... love learning!”
“Please discipline me well from now on, Mom Lu!”

paragraphs: Gu Chengye said that with such a resounding and powerful tone.
It was as if the little guy who had stubbornly refused to attend class just a moment ago wasn’t him at all.
However, just as he was preparing to continue delivering a declaration of studying.
An invisible force suddenly enveloped him.
Swoosh!
Gu Chengye only felt his body lighten.
The next moment, his entire body flew straight out.
“Ahhh——”
After spinning in the air a few times, he landed steadily on the courtyard’s swing.
Although he didn’t suffer the slightest injury, his head was left somewhat dazed from the swaying.
“Did you waste all those etiquette classes?”
A voice came from beside the dining table.
“Who told you to stand on the table?”
The person who made a move was none other than Yang Fan.
Gu Chengye clutched his head with a wronged expression, “Dad...”
But Yang Fan didn’t buy into this act at all.
“Reflect properly on the swing for me, and eat properly when it’s time to eat.”
When it comes to educating children, having one parent lenient and the other strict makes it easier for the child to find a balance.
Gu Le, being the biological mother, clearly belonged to the “lenient” side; as long as her son was happy, she was willing to go along with many things.
Because of this, Yang Fan as the father naturally had to take on more of the “strict” role.
Otherwise... Gu Chengye might really grow up all the way into a mischievous Demon King.
“I know.” Gu Chengye said with an aggrieved look.
Just at this moment, Lu Wan suddenly spoke:
“Husband, Yang Chenglu has already been born.”
“Tonight, I plan to hold a small banquet in the Virtual World.”
“The attendees will mainly be acquaintances, and it’s also considered letting the child show his face in advance.”
“I plan to let Yang Chengrou and Gu Chengye participate as well.”
“That way, when they undergo Awakening for their Divine Kingdoms in the future, they can get to know some uncles and aunts in advance.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded.
“You can arrange these, but my parents don’t need to attend.”
“They aren’t very suited to this kind of occasion.”
Last time Gu Chengye’s full-month banquet was held, it was in Primordial City within the Virtual World.
At that time, to show importance attached to Yang Fan, Gu Xuanting had specially invited Yang Fan’s parents over as well.
The original intention was naturally good, but after that banquet ended, the two elders took a full few days to recover.
After all, they used to be ordinary people, suddenly surrounded by a group of high-and-mighty gods, with the Five Great Families and top figures of the Federation...
Such a scene was simply too stimulating for them.
“Alright, Husband.”
Lu Wan nodded.
“It is indeed easy for the elders to feel constrained if they come, so this time we’ll handle it ourselves.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan suddenly put down the tableware in his hand.
“After the banquet ends... the three of us will hold a Clan meeting.”
Gu Le and Lu Wan were both somewhat surprised upon hearing this.
Previously at home, Yang Fan was basically in a completely loafing-about state.
Aside from paying the “public grain”, the thing he was most enthusiastic about was probably lying back on the massage chair and entering the Virtual World to relax and entertain himself.
But now... he actually wanted to hold a Clan meeting?
Moreover, looking at Yang Fan’s expression at this moment, it was clearly not just a casual remark.
This head of the Clan suddenly became serious, and the two women were somewhat unaccustomed to it for a moment.
The banquet’s invitation list was all screened and distributed by Lu Wan’s intelligent lifeform.
The number of people coming to attend the banquet was not small.
By evening, Lu Wan first personally helped Yang Chenglu put on a baby-specific virtual helmet, and then the Clan entered the Virtual World together.
Lu Wan directly set the banquet location on a Vacation Planet.
This Vacation Planet was originally a property under Lu Wan’s name.
For this banquet, she even had the intelligent lifeform clear out all tourists on the entire planet in advance.
Aside from the necessary service personnel, the entire living planet became the venue for this banquet.
The Clan had just teleported to the Vacation Planet when a Tier 3 God immediately stepped forward to greet them, bowing respectfully and saluting.
“President Lu, the banquet’s main hall has been completely set up.”
“Open the coordinates.”
Lu Wan said indifferently.
“Distinguished guests will arrive one after another shortly.”
“Yes, President Lu.”
That Tier 3 God quickly acknowledged.
“The entire planet’s entertainment facilities have all been opened for free, and the welcoming procedure has been rehearsed hundreds of times to ensure no problems occur.”
Lu Wan nodded and did not continue speaking much.
She pushed Yang Chenglu’s stroller with one hand, linked arms with Yang Fan with the other, and slowly walked up the red carpet paved with flowers.
At this moment, when Yang Fan raised his head to see everything in front of him, his entire person froze for a second.
The entire Vacation Planet seemed to have turned into a huge celebration.
Both sides of the streets, the exterior walls of giant buildings, commercial squares, and even some mountain peaks were hung all over with baby photos of Yang Chenglu.
In the sky, a large number of flying ships shuttled back and forth.
These flying ships were not used to carry people, but were specially responsible for hanging huge banners.
“Congratulations to the Master and Mistress on the birth of a precious son!”
“Wishing Yang Chenglu healthy growth!”
“May his blessings be long-lasting! May his life be smooth and successful!”
Even the greenery on the Vacation Planet had been re-pruned.
Looking from afar, some huge bushes formed the two words “Welcome”.
There were also large areas of flower seas meticulously pruned into the two characters “Chenglu”.
This wasn’t something that could be achieved by simply modifying data.
The Virtual World was originally restored one-to-one according to the Real World.
What was seen before the eyes was not just a few light and shadow special effects.
For this banquet, the entire Vacation Planet had undergone a truly meaningful massive construction project.
Roads were re-paved, buildings re-decorated, and greenery was transplanted and pruned on a large scale.
This was no longer holding a banquet, it was clearly transforming the entire living planet into a huge celebration site.
Yang Fan lowered his head and glanced at Yang Chenglu, who was sleeping like a little pig in the stroller, and couldn’t help but generate a trace of envy in his heart.
Sometimes one had to admit... reincarnation is truly a technical craft.
This little guy hasn’t done anything yet, and he’s already close to the top of “Rome”.
“Wan’er...”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but laugh through his tears.
“Is this what you call a banquet?”
He originally thought that the so-called banquet meant finding an advanced restaurant, then inviting some familiar friends and business partners to gather in the name of the child’s birth.
By the way, letting the outside world know that the Yang Clan has added a new member.
But after seeing this scene before him, Yang Fan suddenly felt... his experience was still far too little.
One can only say... rich people really know how to play.
“Husband.”
Lu Wan, however, had a serious expression.
“Doing business pays the utmost attention to pomp and circumstance.”
“Many of the people coming today are potential partners we might cooperate with in the future.”

“When Chenglu undergoes Awakening for his Divine Kingdom in the future and truly begins to take over the Clan’s industries, if these big figures can still recall from their memories that they once saw this child, then everything today will not have been in vain.”
“Today’s hustle and bustle might not immediately bring anything.”
“But many years from now, it might just be a very valuable connection.”
Lu Wan said very seriously.
After listening, Yang Fan only nodded and didn’t say much more.
Regarding how to cultivate the next generation, he was indeed not good at it.
He still quite agreed that rather than demanding how strong the child should be, it is better for the parents to work hard themselves.
As long as he himself was strong enough, as long as he could stand high enough in the future.
Even if his three sons did nothing at all, they were destined to become people above others.
(That’s a Wrap!)
