chapters.title: Chapter 511: Planning Far Ahead for One's Child
paragraphs: “Mother Lu!”
An excited voice suddenly rang out.
Gu Chengye ran over quickly.
“Can I go ride that Dragon?”
“I’ve never seen one this big in any other amusement park!”
Gu Chengye said while pointing into the distance.
In a valley in the distance, a behemoth was coiled upon the earth.
That was unexpectedly a real Dragon!
Its entire body was covered in dark red scales, and deep red flames continuously spewed out from the gaps between the scales.
Its body reached a thousand zhang in length, and just lying there, it possessed a terrifying might that made one’s heart palpitate.
“You can.”
Lu Wan nodded indifferently.
“However, you are too young right now.”
“When riding, you need a God-level staff member to accompany you.”
“Yay!” Gu Chengye immediately jumped up in excitement.
These Dragons were creatures specially nurtured within the Divine Kingdom.
In order to make them serve as entertainment projects for the Vacation Planet, Lu Wan even invested a large amount of Resources to conduct long-term domestication and training on these Dragons.
“I’m going first!”
Gu Chengye shouted excitedly and then bolted away into the distance.
“Remember to come back in half an hour!” Gu Le hurriedly shouted from behind.
“Got it, my dear mother!”
Gu Chengye didn’t even look back.
During this period, the little fellow had clearly gained a lot of weight again.
When his two short little legs ran, his whole person was round and roly-poly.
Looked at from afar, he was just like a running little meatball.
Gu Le watched his departing back and couldn’t help sighing, “This brat is getting harder and harder to manage.”
“Let him make a fuss.”
Yang Fan smiled and shook his head.
“However, after returning, we must arrange a professional medical team for him. This fat on his body must be reduced for me.”
“A child of only a few years old, eating and drinking blindly everywhere every day.”
“If this goes on, he’s going to grow into a ball.”
Gu Chengye had just run to the entrance when he saw a few familiar figures.
“Mother Luo Rou! Mother Luo Bing!”
“Big Brother!”
Gu Chengye immediately waved his small hands and shouted loudly.
Before Luo Rou could respond, the little fellow had already rushed over and grabbed Yang Chengrou’s hand.
“The banquet hasn’t started yet! Big Brother and I will go ride that Dragon first!”
After speaking, Gu Chengye directly dragged Yang Chengrou and ran outside.

Although Yang Chengrou was a few years older than him and taller by a head, facing this younger brother’s hand strength, he couldn’t break free for a moment and could only be forcibly dragged forward by Gu Chengye.
“You guys... be safe!”
Luo Rou hurriedly shouted from behind.
Ever since moving to Xiling Planet, Luo Rou had seen quite a few big scenes.
Even under Ma Yu’s arrangement, she had also taken her family to the largest Vacation Planet in the Battlefront Star Sector.
But this time, following the coordinates sent by Lu Wan to arrive here, she was still deeply shocked by the scene before her eyes.
Especially that Dragon in the distance.
Separated by such a distance, Luo Rou could still feel the terrifying aura emanating from the other party.
You must know that she now relied on a large amount of Resources to finally breakthrough to the demigod Realm.
But the feeling that Dragon gave her was dangerous to the extreme.
If this level of creature suddenly appeared within her Divine Kingdom, I am afraid it could cause unimaginable destruction in an instant.
“Sister.”
Luo Bing on the side couldn’t help reminding.
“Don’t let concern make you flustered, this is the Virtual World.”
Hearing these words, Luo Rou then reacted.
She gently patted her own forehead and turned to look at Luo Bing, saying.
“Luo Bing, later when you see the two older sisters, you must keep a low profile.”
“After all, there are still many outsiders here today, don’t crowd around husband, understand?”
Luo Bing immediately nodded, “I understand.”
Actually, both women were clear in their hearts.
Although nominally Yang Fan’s wives, there was a huge gap between them and Gu Le and Lu Wan.
Even in a sense... they were simply not people of the same world.
Being able to be invited to attend the banquet this time was precisely because of Yang Fan’s relationship.
Naturally, they wouldn’t treat themselves as masters, today they just needed to quietly stand aside and play the role of green leaves.
Saying more leads to more mistakes, at a banquet of this level, being cautious in speech and action is far more important than deliberately showing oneself off.
At the very least, they couldn’t make a fool of themselves.
Soon, under the guidance of the service personnel, Luo Rou and Luo Bing came to the main banquet hall.
From afar, the two saw Yang Fan.
Luo Rou and Luo Bing hurriedly walked forward.
“Husband, hello to the two older sisters.”
The two women slightly bowed.
Nowadays, the number of times Yang Fan took time to return to Xiling Planet to see them was getting fewer and fewer.
Therefore, every time they saw Yang Fan, the two women were a bit more restrained than before.
“We are all family, don’t be so polite.”
Yang Fan casually waved his hand, “Where is that little fellow Yang Chengrou?”
“He just went to play together with Gu Chengye.”
“That’s good.”
Yang Fan smiled.
“One is too obedient, one is too disobedient.”
“It can just neutralize each other.”
Hearing these words, Luo Rou and Luo Bing clearly relaxed a lot.
The two then took out a red envelope and carefully placed it beside the sleeping Yang Chenglu.
Lu Wan was a deity after all, and with just a sweep of her Mental Strength, she knew exactly what was inside.
A trace of a smile appeared on her face, “The two younger sisters have put in thought.”
“As long as Big Sister doesn’t disdain it.”
Luo Rou hurriedly waved her hand.
“They are all family children, just a little token of affection.”
Lu Wan nodded.
“We are all family, you can visit more often in the future.”
Saying that, she looked at Luo Rou again.
“Especially Yang Chengrou, Gu Chengye and Yang Chenglu are all his biological brothers, getting along more is a good thing after all.”
“Okay!” Hearing this, Luo Rou hurriedly nodded.
Although her expression still maintained respect, a trace of joy clearly flashed in the depths of her eyes.
Because she knew very well the weight of Lu Wan’s words.
All along, Luo Rou had been very self-aware.
She knew the gap between herself and Gu Le and Lu Wan.
Even in private, she had specially taught Yang Chengrou.
“When getting along with Gu Chengye, he should yield more to his younger brother.”
“He cannot offend him, and even less order him about.”
Although the two children were biological brothers, the Resources and starting points possessed by both sides were vastly different.
Yang Fan’s other two children were destined to possess extremely massive backgrounds and connections in the future, and were even very likely to become benefactors in Yang Chengrou’s life.
If her own child carried the title of “Big Brother” and thought he was superior to others, that would truly be foolish.
Now having obtained Lu Wan’s approval, Luo Rou instantly had new plans in her heart.
After returning, she could appropriately reduce some of Yang Chengrou’s coursework.
It was not that she wouldn’t let him study.
Rather, it was to free up more time for him to go to the Virtual World more often and play together with Gu Chengye.
What children needed in the future was not just knowledge.
She hired the best teachers for Yang Chengrou, letting him study politics, economics, law, and Divine Kingdom knowledge from a young age, all for his future.
Cultivating brotherly affection with the real young master and accumulating connections for him was likewise for his future.
A mother’s love plans far ahead for her child.
Luo Rou was not stupid, and naturally knew which was lighter and which was heavier.

chapters.title: Chapter 512: Stumbling Into the Celestial Family
paragraphs: As time passed, more and more guests walked into the banquet hall along the red carpet.
Figure after figure, regardless of gender, all exuded powerful divine auras from their bodies.
“CEO Lu, Brother Yang, long time no see!”
A familiar voice came over.
Yang Fan looked up, and the person who came was none other than Gu Tianyu.
Back in Primordial City, it was this person who took the initiative to approach him, wanting to trade the Eternal Corpse Mine with him.
“Brother Gu, please come in!” Yang Fan walked up with a smile.
Towards Gu Tianyu, he still felt quite grateful in his heart.
Although the prices of various items in the Dark Web were ridiculously expensive, they were extremely suitable for himself.
Nowadays, the fact that Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom could possess such a terrifying foundation was largely thanks to Gu Tianyu’s introduction back then.
“Meeting again today, I didn’t expect Brother Yang to already possess such strength.”
Gu Tianyu said with a smile.
“Especially recently, Yang Corporation’s actions have not been small at all; even I have heard a lot of news.”
“Just minor antics.” Yang Fan responded with a smile.
And this sentence really wasn’t purely out of modesty.
After entering the Dark Web through Gu Tianyu back then, Yang Fan had specifically investigated the other party’s identity.
Gu Tianyu was an important figure in the Gu Family’s commercial system, and he owned an extremely large-scale investment company under his name.
Moreover, this company now directly or indirectly held controlling stakes in twelve large enterprises on the Federal main board.
Even High-Order Gods like Gu Xuanting were among the shareholders of this company.
The most exaggerated thing was... Gu Tianyu was not even five hundred years old now.
In terms of business ability, the Resources he controlled, and the influence behind him, he could definitely be considered one of the top figures among the younger generation Yang Fan knew.
Perhaps even Lu Wan would be slightly inferior by half a notch.
“Brother Yang is too modest.”
Gu Tianyu smiled and shook his head.
“I am very optimistic about the future of Yang Corporation.”
“If Brother Yang has any thoughts of selling shares in the future, we can completely find some time to talk it over properly.”
“If there is truly a need in the future, I will definitely ask Brother Gu for help.” Yang Fan immediately responded with a smile.
Yang Fan didn’t lack Divinity Points at all, and in his planning, going public was never considered.
As for the group’s shares... it was even more impossible for them to flow to outsiders.
What he wanted was a commercial tool completely controlled in his own hands, rather than a listed company that needed to be responsible to external shareholders.
Therefore, Yang Fan naturally could not agree to Gu Tianyu’s proposal.
However, there was no need to spell these things out to his face.
Gu Tianyu didn’t continue to chat deeply, but smiled instead, and took out a document from his portable space.
“CEO Lu’s timing in sending out invitations this time was really a bit rushed, and I didn’t have time to prepare any special gift.”
“Then let’s gift him a Vacation Planet in the Luotian Starfield. It was prepared a bit hastily, and I hope CEO Lu won’t disdain it.”
As he spoke, he gently placed the document beside Yang Chenglu.
Looking at that document, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
Lu Wan, on the other hand, had a calm expression and even turned sideways very naturally.
“President Gu is joking. This gift is already valuable enough, please come in.”
Gu Tianyu smiled and nodded, then walked toward the interior of the banquet hall.
In the corner of the banquet hall, Luo Rou and Luo Bing had already fallen into complete silence.
On their two pretty faces, there was the same expression at this moment.
Small mouths slightly open, minds dazed.
A... Vacation Planet?
When they learned that Lu Wan was pregnant, they had started preparing gifts early on.
Those two red envelopes, seemingly ordinary, actually took a lot of thought and effort from them.

From various branded toys the child played with when young, to game recharge cards for the Virtual World, to advanced learning devices and virtual learning permissions that could be used after starting school, as well as various meticulously prepared educational Resources.
Even some of the basic buildings that might be used after Awakening the Divine Kingdom in the future were prepared in advance.
Some were practical, while others were purely to make the child happy.
But now... gifting a living planet, and a Vacation Planet at that!
What the hell is this?
Ever since arriving at Xiling Planet, the two women had gained quite a bit of insight.
They naturally knew that Vacation Planets were the category with the highest development cost among all living planets.
Purchasing the planet itself might not be much.
What was truly terrifying was the subsequent cost.

The relocation and resettlement of indigenous people, the transformation of the ecological environment, the construction of various large-scale entertainment facilities, as well as the construction and long-term maintenance of space shipping lanes.
With this entire set down, the cost was simply an astronomical figure.
Let alone them, even if the entire Luo Family were sold, it would probably only barely serve as a throw-in.
Luo Bing swallowed hard.
“Sis... We’d better stand a bit closer to the edge.”
Luo Rou was silent for two seconds, “Mn.”
The two of them quietly leaned further into the corner.
After coming to Xiling Planet, with the support of Yang Corporation, they had also established their own company, and their hearts actually gradually gained a bit more confidence.
But today... after seeing the gifts these guests sent out one after another.
They suddenly realized how ridiculous they actually were.
These were simply not people from the same world.
Stumbling into the Celestial Household, pure and simple!
As time passed, more and more guests came to attend the banquet.
Among them were Lu Wan’s business partners and friends from the Five Great Families.
Even some staff members from the Federal Government made a special trip to deliver a red envelope and greet Yang Fan by the way.
“Brother Yang, you move fast enough!”
A familiar voice came over, and Han Jue walked over together with Qin Zheng and Sima Tianci.
“You and CEO Lu are both major shareholders of Star Group, so the three of us put together a big red envelope for this little fellow.”
As he spoke, Han Jue placed the prepared red envelope beside the stroller.
“Too polite.” Yang Fan greeted with a smile, “Please come in, you few.”
“Brother Yang, I’m not late, am I?”
Just at this moment, another voice came from behind.
Yang Fan turned his head to look, and the people who came were unexpectedly Sima Zhao and Sima Yurao.
This actually surprised Yang Fan a bit; he hadn’t expected Lu Wan to send invitations even to them.
“Big Brother Sima, please come in!”
Yang Fan went up to greet them with a smile.
Sima Zhao wasn’t polite either. Just as he was about to enter the hall, his gaze fell on Sima Tianci.
“Little Brother Tianci is here too.”
“However, your complexion looks a bit ugly. Didn’t sleep well last night?”
“Indeed didn’t sleep very well.” Sima Tianci faked a smile and said.
“Business is business.”
Sima Zhao stepped forward and patted Sima Tianci on the shoulder.
“Regarding the share issue of that tech company, I have mediated many times.”
“It’s just that Aunt Gu holds too much equity. If she is unwilling to sell a portion of her shares, the fourth round of angel financing will probably be hard to succeed.”
“I also hope younger brother can understand your elder brother’s difficulties.”
“Understood.” Sima Tianci nodded.
“That’s good.”
Sima Zhao said with a smile.
“When we have time, we brothers will get together again.”
Having said that, he led Sima Yurao into the banquet hall.
Before leaving, he did not forget to leave a red envelope in the stroller.
After the two walked away, Han Jue couldn’t help poking Sima Tianci on the shoulder.
“Is the internal competition in your Sima Family this fierce?”
